properties.name: spring.flutter.debug.enabled

properties.name: spring.flutter.debug.frame-meter.enabled
properties.description: Whether the app has the feature: `true` in every build, `false` in none (the build leaves its code out), not set in debug and profile builds only (a release build compiles it away).

properties.name: spring.flutter.debug.motion.enabled
properties.description: Whether the app has the feature: `true` in every build, `false` in none (the build leaves its code out), not set in debug and profile builds only (a release build compiles it away).

properties.name: spring.flutter.debug.overlays.drag.remember
properties.description: Whether a moved overlay is where it was left after the app restarts.

properties.name: spring.flutter.debug.overlays.drag.snap

properties.name: spring.flutter.debug.overlays.layout

properties.name: spring.flutter.debug.overlays.margin.bottom

properties.name: spring.flutter.debug.overlays.margin.left
properties.description: Left of the left corners.

properties.name: spring.flutter.debug.overlays.margin.right
properties.description: Right of the right corners.

properties.name: spring.flutter.debug.overlays.margin.top
properties.description: Above the top corners.

properties.name: spring.flutter.debug.overlays.max-height
properties.description: The room of a corner for `auto`, a fraction of the screen's height.

properties.name: spring.flutter.debug.timeline.enabled
properties.description: Whether the app has the timeline: `true` in every build, `false` in none (the build leaves its code out), not set in debug and profile builds only (a release build compiles it away).

properties.name: spring.flutter.debug.timeline.position
properties.description: The corner its pill shows in.

properties.name: spring.flutter.desktop.window.initial-size
properties.description: The size of the window at start, as WIDTHxHEIGHT in logical pixels, e.g. 1280x800.

properties.name: spring.flutter.desktop.window.max-size
properties.description: The largest size of the window, as WIDTHxHEIGHT.

properties.name: spring.flutter.desktop.window.min-size
properties.description: The smallest size of the window, as WIDTHxHEIGHT.

properties.name: spring.flutter.desktop.window.title
properties.description: The title of the desktop window.

properties.name: spring.flutter.desktop.window.title-bar
properties.description: How the title bar of the desktop window looks: `default` (the platform's), `transparent` (the app draws under a transparent title bar) or `hidden` (no title bar; the app draws its own).

properties.name: spring.flutter.fonts.auto-load
properties.description: Whether the fonts named by the theme are loaded from the assets.

properties.name: spring.flutter.fonts.exclude
properties.description: Asset globs the font loader skips.

properties.name: spring.flutter.fonts.families.*.files
properties.description: The asset files of the family (`assets/fonts/NotoSansJP.woff2`); a file's format is any the platform reads (`.ttf`, `.otf`; `.woff2` on the web).

properties.name: spring.flutter.fonts.families.*.languages
properties.description: The languages the family is for (`ja`, `zh-Hant`): loaded before the first frame when the app starts in one of them, else when it switches to one. None: loaded before the first frame, always.

properties.description: Whether the meter shows. Off by default; turn it on in a profile you test with, not for your users.

properties.name: spring.flutter.frame-meter.position
properties.description: The corner of the screen it shows in.

properties.description: The frames a second the screen is meant to show: a frame within `1 / target-rate` is good, up to twice that a warning, more a drop.

properties.name: spring.flutter.lifecycle.pause-in-background
properties.description: Whether scheduled work pauses while the app is in the background.

properties.name: spring.flutter.markdown.placeholders
properties.description: Replaces each `{{key}}` of a page by the value of the configuration's key (`{{site.version}}`); one whose key has no value stays as it is, and `\{{` writes `{{`. The build's pages for search engines do the same (`BracePlaceholders`).

properties.name: spring.flutter.scan-os-environment
properties.description: Whether the operating system environment is read as properties. The application reads it before it has an environment, from the `--dart-define` values (`scanOsEnvironmentIn`).

properties.name: spring.flutter.shortcuts.*
properties.description: The keys of each keyboard shortcut's action (`search.open: primary+k`): one or a list, `primary` being ⌘ on Apple's platforms and Ctrl elsewhere, `char:?` a character. They run the action's `@Shortcut` methods and `ShortcutHandler` beans.

properties.name: spring.flutter.splash.frame-budget
properties.description: The work between two frames when [yieldFrames] is on.

properties.name: spring.flutter.splash.tasks.enabled
properties.description: Runs the `SplashTask` beans before the app is shown; `false`: none runs, the beans take the whole loader.

properties.name: spring.flutter.splash.tasks.share
properties.description: The share of the splash's loader the tasks take, from 0 to 1, when the app has any.

properties.name: spring.flutter.splash.tasks.timeout
properties.description: How long the splash waits for the tasks; one still running goes on behind the app.

properties.name: spring.flutter.splash.trace
properties.description: Measures the start: each stage of the splash and each bean's creation with its time, in the log at the end; on the web also as marks of the browser's performance timeline (the Performance tab). Off by default.

properties.name: spring.flutter.splash.warm-up.text.chunk
properties.description: How many characters are laid out in one frame, so the splash keeps moving on a phone.

properties.name: spring.flutter.splash.warm-up.text.enabled
properties.description: Lays out the characters of the app's text while the splash shows. Off by default; worth it on the web, where the fonts for Japanese, Chinese or emoji are downloaded.

properties.name: spring.flutter.splash.warm-up.text.first-font
properties.description: No font downloaded in that time: none is needed.

properties.name: spring.flutter.splash.warm-up.text.resources
properties.description: The files whose characters are laid out (location patterns).

properties.name: spring.flutter.splash.warm-up.text.settle
properties.description: After a font came in, how long without another before the warm-up ends.

properties.name: spring.flutter.splash.yield-frames
properties.description: Lets Flutter draw a frame while the beans are created, so the splash keeps moving: after [frameBudget] of work the start waits for the next frame. On by default on the web, off elsewhere; `false` turns it off (no pacer at all).

properties.name: spring.flutter.web.dev-server.base-href
properties.description: The path the app is served under; starts and ends with /.

properties.name: spring.flutter.web.dev-server.content-security-policy

properties.description: Origins added to the `connect-src` of spa mode's ready policy: the APIs the app calls, a provider's endpoints on other hosts. Default: none.

properties.name: spring.flutter.web.dev-server.content-security-policy-report-only
properties.description: Whether `content-security-policy` is sent as `Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only`: the browser reports what the policy would block and blocks nothing. `false` (the default) enforces it.

properties.name: spring.flutter.web.dev-server.headers.*
properties.description: A header added to every response of the web dev server.

properties.name: spring.flutter.web.dev-server.host
properties.description: The address the dev server of flutter run on the web listens on, e.g. localhost or 0.0.0.0.

properties.name: spring.flutter.web.dev-server.https.cert-key-path
properties.description: The private key (PEM) of the certificate.

properties.name: spring.flutter.web.dev-server.https.cert-path
properties.description: The TLS certificate (PEM) of the web dev server.

properties.name: spring.flutter.web.dev-server.port
properties.description: The port of the web dev server; 0 picks a free port.

properties.name: spring.flutter.web.dev-server.proxy[*].prefix
properties.description: Rule `n` matches paths starting with it (`/api/`). Default: none.

properties.name: spring.flutter.web.dev-server.proxy[*].regex
properties.description: Or the paths matching it; each rule sets exactly one of `prefix` and `regex`. Default: none.

properties.description: The forwarded path: the matched part replaced, `$1` for the first group. Default: the path unchanged.

properties.name: spring.flutter.web.dev-server.proxy[*].target

properties.description: The most pixels for each point Flutter draws at, written into `web/index.html` by the build. A phone's screen has 3: every frame is 9 times the pixels of the page, and its graphics chip drops frames on a full-screen scroll. 2 draws 2.25 times fewer, the text still sharp. `null`: the screen's own.

properties.name: spring.flutter.web.page.swipe-to-close
properties.description: Whether a swipe down may close the page where the browser does so: an app's own browser (a messenger's, a social app's). `false` keeps the page open; the swipe then scrolls the app.

properties.name: spring.flutter.web.page.translate
properties.description: Whether browsers and Google may offer to translate the page. Flutter draws its text on a canvas, so a translator finds none: `false` writes `translate="no"` and `<meta name="google" content="notranslate">` into `web/index.html`, and the offer is gone.

properties.name: spring.flutter.web.seo.content[*].exclude
properties.description: Files left out, globs below the folder (`_*.md`).

properties.name: spring.flutter.web.seo.content[*].location
properties.description: The folder (`resources:content/blog/`).

properties.name: spring.flutter.web.seo.content[*].path
properties.description: The address of the folder (`/blog`): `first.md` is `/blog/first`, `index.md` is `/blog`.

properties.name: spring.flutter.web.seo.description
properties.description: The description of a page that has none.

properties.name: spring.flutter.web.seo.enabled
properties.description: Whether the build writes the pages.

properties.name: spring.flutter.web.seo.exclude
properties.description: Files of every Markdown folder, the routes' and `content[n]`'s, that make no page: globs from the folder (`**/contents*.md`, a table of contents the site reads for its menu). `*` matches within a folder, `**` across folders, and `**/` no folder too.

properties.name: spring.flutter.web.seo.from-routes
properties.description: Whether every screen of `spring_boot_starter_flutter_navigation` is a page (its title, `@RouteInfo`, its Markdown).

properties.name: spring.flutter.web.seo.image
properties.description: The preview image of a page that has none (`resources:images/og.png`). Link previews (messengers, X, Slack) show it large: about 1200×630.

properties.name: spring.flutter.web.seo.lastmod
properties.description: Whether the sitemap gives each Markdown page its `lastmod`: the day of the last commit that changed its file (`git log`); none in a shallow clone, whose one commit would date every page (a CI checkout needs `fetch-depth: 0`).

properties.name: spring.flutter.web.seo.llms
properties.description: Whether `llms.txt` and `llms-full.txt` are written.

properties.name: spring.flutter.web.seo.markdown

properties.name: spring.flutter.web.seo.page-files
properties.description: How a page's file is named: `directory` (`<path>/index.html`, which a static host serves after a redirect to `<path>/`, so the page's addresses end with `/`) or `html` (`<path>.html`, which Cloudflare Pages, GitHub Pages and Netlify serve at `<path>` with no redirect).

properties.name: spring.flutter.web.seo.pages[*].description
properties.description: Its description.

properties.name: spring.flutter.web.seo.pages[*].image
properties.description: Its preview image.

properties.name: spring.flutter.web.seo.pages[*].index
properties.description: `false`: search engines may not list it (`noindex`, not in the sitemap).

properties.name: spring.flutter.web.seo.pages[*].path
properties.description: The page's address (`/`).

properties.name: spring.flutter.web.seo.pages[*].title

properties.name: spring.flutter.web.seo.site-name
properties.description: The site's name in a link preview (`og:site_name`).

properties.name: spring.flutter.web.seo.site-url
properties.description: The site's address (`https://spring-dart.dev`), for the absolute addresses of `canonical`, `og:url` and the sitemap; required when [enabled]. Its path is where the app is served.

properties.name: spring.flutter.web.seo.sitemap
properties.description: Whether `sitemap.xml` and `robots.txt` are written.

properties.name: spring.flutter.web.seo.title
properties.description: The page's `<title>`; `{title}` is the page's own.

properties.name: motion.enabled
properties.description: Whether the app moves at all: `false` makes every page transition, text and content change, scroll to the top and theme animation instant, as the device's "reduce motion" does.

properties.name: motion.page-transition
properties.description: How a new screen comes in, on every platform: a kind, or a map of `type`, `duration`, `curve`.

properties.name: motion.page-transition.type
properties.description: The map form's kind.

properties.name: motion.page-transition.duration
properties.description: How long the transition takes.

properties.name: motion.page-transition.curve
properties.description: The curve of the transition.

properties.name: motion.text-change
properties.description: What a `ThemeText` does when its text changes (another language): at once, a cross-fade, or `morph`, character after character from the start of the line. A kind, or a map of `type`, `duration`, `curve`, `stagger`.

properties.name: motion.text-change.type
properties.description: The map form's kind.

properties.name: motion.text-change.keep-unchanged
properties.description: For `morph`: `true` keeps the characters that are the same in the old and the new text, so only the changed part runs through glyphs; `false` runs the wave over the whole line.

properties.name: motion.text-change.duration
properties.description: How long the whole change takes.

properties.name: motion.text-change.curve
properties.description: The curve of the change.

properties.name: motion.text-change.stagger
properties.description: For `morph`, how much later each character starts than the one before it.

properties.name: motion.text-change.glyphs
properties.description: For `morph`: the characters a changing character runs through, taken as written (no `$` references).

properties.name: motion.text-change.glyph-duration
properties.description: For `morph`: how long each glyph shows before the next.

properties.name: motion.overscroll
properties.description: What a scrollable shows when pulled past its end: the app type's own (`platform`: Material's stretch on Android, which distorts the content) or nothing (`none`).

properties.name: motion.wheel-scroll
properties.description: How a mouse wheel scrolls every scrollable of the app: `none` (the default) moves by the wheel's step at once, as Flutter does; a map of `duration` and `speed` eases each step and scales it.

properties.name: motion.wheel-scroll.duration
properties.description: How long a step of the wheel takes to arrive.

properties.name: motion.wheel-scroll.speed
properties.description: The share of the wheel's step: below 1 slower, above faster.

properties.name: motion.wheel-scroll.inertia
properties.description: The inertia of scrolling, each kind of pointer its own: `none` (the default), or a map of `mouse`, `trackpad` and `touch`.

properties.name: motion.wheel-scroll.inertia.mouse
properties.description: What each quick step of the wheel in a row adds to the next (0.2: a fifth more), and the longer glide of a fast run; 0 for none.

properties.name: motion.wheel-scroll.inertia.trackpad
properties.description: How much of its last step the page keeps each frame once the fingers stop on the trackpad (0.9 glides on); 0 for none, for a system that glides by itself.

properties.name: motion.wheel-scroll.inertia.touch
properties.description: How much further a flick of the finger throws the page (0.5: half again as far); 0 for none.

properties.name: motion.scroll-to-top
properties.description: How a screen goes back to its top when it shows another page (`RouteContentView`): `none` jumps; else a map of `duration` and `curve`.

properties.name: motion.scroll-to-top.duration
properties.description: How long the scroll to the top takes.

properties.name: motion.scroll-to-top.curve
properties.description: The curve of the scroll to the top.

properties.name: motion.content-change
properties.description: How a part of a screen shows other content in its place (another page in `RouteContentView`, `ContentChange`): at once, a cross-fade, a cross-fade rising a little, or `morph`, the new page typing itself in line after line; a kind of the app's own with `ContentTransitions.register`. A kind, or a map of `type`, `duration`, `curve`, `stagger`, `delay`.

properties.name: motion.content-change.type
properties.description: The map form's kind; a kind of the app's own too.

properties.name: motion.content-change.duration
properties.description: How long the change takes; for `morph`, the whole page.

properties.name: motion.content-change.curve
properties.description: The curve of the change.

properties.name: motion.content-change.stagger
properties.description: For `morph`: how much later each line starts than the one before it; the starts take at most 85 percent of the duration.

properties.name: motion.content-change.delay
properties.description: For `morph`: how long the new page waits, blank at its full height, before its first line (the duration of `text-change`, so a text above it morphs first).

properties.description: The color of the highlight that crosses a skeleton.

properties.description: How long the highlight takes to cross a skeleton.

properties.description: The curve of the highlight: a name or four numbers.

properties.name: loaders.*.shimmer.angle
properties.description: The slant of the highlight in degrees.

properties.name: loaders.*.animation.duration
properties.description: How long one run of a built-in loader takes. `animation` may also be the name of an `animations.<name>`.

properties.name: loaders.*.animation.curve
properties.description: The curve of the run: a name or four numbers.

properties.name: loaders.*.animation.repeat
properties.description: What happens at the end of a run.

properties.name: loaders.*.phases.*.duration
properties.description: A kind of the app's own: how long the phase takes. Phases play in the order written.

properties.name: loaders.*.phases.*.curve
properties.description: The curve of the phase: a name or four numbers.

properties.name: loaders.*.phases.*.repeat
properties.description: A looping phase goes on until the loader is ready.

properties.name: loaders.*.phases.*.progress
properties.description: A phase that follows the progress the loader is given (`true`).

properties.name: loaders.*.phases.*.min-duration
properties.description: A phase that follows progress fills in no less than this: it shows the smaller of the real progress and the time in the phase (eased) over this, so a fast start does not jump to the end.

properties.name: loaders.*.web
properties.description: A kind of the app's own: the HTML that shows it before Flutter runs (the web page loader). A path below `lib/resources/` (the app's or a package's), or an address the build downloads: `https://...` or `github:owner/repo/path@ref`.

properties.name: loaders.*.web-sha256
properties.description: For a downloaded `web`: the SHA-256 (64 hexadecimal digits) the file must have; another file is refused.

properties.name: loaders.*.tracks.*.follows
properties.description: What the track (a value from 0 to 1 a loader reads each frame) follows: `time` (the clock), `stage` (from a stage of the start on), `progress` (the start's progress, smoothed), or a driver of the app's own (`LoaderTrackDrivers.register`).

properties.name: loaders.*.tracks.*.duration
properties.description: A time or stage track: how long one run takes.

properties.name: loaders.*.tracks.*.curve
properties.description: The curve of the track: a name or four numbers.

properties.name: loaders.*.tracks.*.repeat
properties.description: A time or stage track: once, looping, or back and forth.

properties.name: loaders.*.tracks.*.delay
properties.description: A time or stage track: how long it waits before it starts.

properties.name: loaders.*.tracks.*.from
properties.description: A stage track: the stage it starts at.

properties.name: loaders.*.tracks.*.smoothing
properties.description: A progress track: how fast it catches up with the progress (a time constant), so it never jumps.

properties.name: loaders.*.tracks.*.*
properties.description: A track of a driver of the app's own takes the keys it declares.

properties.name: loaders.*.*
properties.description: A kind of the app's own takes the keys it registered; their values are read like tokens.

properties.name: splash.background.effect
properties.description: How the image moves.

properties.name: splash.logo.source

properties.name: components.time-picker.hour-minute-shape
properties.description: The shape of the hour and minute controls that the time picker uses.

properties.name: components.time-picker.hour-minute-text-color
properties.description: The color of the header text that represents hours and minutes.

properties.name: components.time-picker.hour-minute-text-style
properties.description: Used to configure the text styles for the hour/minute controls.

properties.name: components.time-picker.input-decoration.style
properties.description: The look of the field: outline draws a box around it, underline a line below it and filled paints the field with a fill color and a line below it. It sets the border and the fill together.

properties.name: components.time-picker.input-decoration.shape
properties.description: The corner shape of the field border. A rounded shape rounds the corners of an outline field and the top corners of a filled one.

properties.name: components.time-picker.input-decoration.border
properties.description: The shape of the border to draw around the decoration's container. The decoration's container is the area which is filled if filled is true and bordered per the border.

properties.name: components.time-picker.input-decoration.filled
properties.description: If true the decoration's container is filled with fill color. Typically this field set to true if border is an underline input border.

properties.name: components.time-picker.input-decoration.fill-color
properties.description: The color to fill the decoration's container with, if filled is true. The decoration's container is the area, defined by the border's get outer path, which is filled if filled is true and bordered per the border.

properties.name: components.time-picker.input-decoration.content-padding
properties.description: The padding for the input decoration's container. The decoration's container is the area which is filled if filled is true and bordered per the border.

properties.name: components.time-picker.input-decoration.label-style
properties.description: The style to use for label text when the label is on top of the input field. When the label text is above (that is, vertically adjacent to) the input field, the text uses the floating label style instead.

properties.name: components.time-picker.input-decoration.floating-label-style
properties.description: The style to use for label text when the label is above (that is, vertically adjacent to) the input field. When the label text is on top of the input field, the text uses the label style instead.

properties.name: components.time-picker.input-decoration.helper-style
properties.description: The style to use for helper text.

properties.name: components.time-picker.input-decoration.helper-max-lines
properties.description: The maximum number of lines the helper text can occupy. This value is passed along to the max lines attribute of the text widget used to display the helper.

properties.name: components.time-picker.input-decoration.hint-style
properties.description: The style to use for the hint text. Also used for the label text when the label text is displayed on top of the input field (that is, at the same location on the screen where text may be entered in the input field).

properties.name: components.time-picker.input-decoration.hint-fade-duration
properties.description: The duration of the hint text fade in and fade out animations.

properties.name: components.time-picker.input-decoration.hint-max-lines
properties.description: The maximum number of lines the hint text can occupy. This value is passed along to the max lines attribute of the text widget used to display the hint text.

properties.name: components.time-picker.input-decoration.error-style
properties.description: The style to use for the error text.

properties.name: components.time-picker.input-decoration.error-max-lines
properties.description: The maximum number of lines the error text can occupy. This value is passed along to the max lines attribute of the text widget used to display the error.

properties.name: components.time-picker.input-decoration.floating-label-behavior
properties.description: Defines **how** the floating label should behave. When auto the label will float to the top only when the field is focused or has some text content, otherwise it will appear in the field in place of the content.

properties.name: components.time-picker.input-decoration.is-dense
properties.description: Whether the input decorator's child is part of a dense form (that is, uses less vertical space).

properties.name: components.time-picker.input-decoration.is-collapsed
properties.description: Whether the decoration is the same size as the input field. A collapsed decoration cannot have label text, error text, or an icon.

properties.name: components.time-picker.input-decoration.icon-color
properties.description: The Color to use for the icon.

properties.name: components.time-picker.input-decoration.prefix-style
properties.description: The style to use for the prefix text.

properties.name: components.time-picker.input-decoration.prefix-icon-color
properties.description: The Color to use for the prefix icon.

properties.name: components.time-picker.input-decoration.prefix-icon-constraints
properties.description: The constraints to use for prefix icon constraints. This can be used to modify the box constraints surrounding prefix icon.

properties.name: components.time-picker.input-decoration.suffix-style
properties.description: The style to use for the suffix text.

properties.name: components.time-picker.input-decoration.suffix-icon-color
properties.description: The Color to use for the suffix icon.

properties.name: components.time-picker.input-decoration.suffix-icon-constraints
properties.description: The constraints to use for suffix icon constraints. This can be used to modify the box constraints surrounding suffix icon.

properties.name: components.time-picker.input-decoration.counter-style
properties.description: The style to use for the counter text.

properties.name: components.time-picker.input-decoration.outline-border
properties.description: The color and width of the border of an outline field.

properties.name: components.time-picker.input-decoration.active-indicator-border
properties.description: The color and width of the line of an underline field.

properties.name: components.time-picker.input-decoration.focus-color
properties.description: The color blended with the fill color while the field has focus.

properties.name: components.time-picker.input-decoration.hover-color
properties.description: The color blended with the fill color while the pointer is over the field.

properties.name: components.time-picker.input-decoration.error-border
properties.description: The border to display when the input decorator does not have the focus and is showing an error.

properties.name: components.time-picker.input-decoration.focused-border
properties.description: The border to display when the input decorator has the focus and is not showing an error.

properties.name: components.time-picker.input-decoration.focused-error-border
properties.description: The border to display when the input decorator has the focus and is showing an error.

properties.name: components.time-picker.input-decoration.disabled-border
properties.description: The border to display when the input decorator is disabled and is not showing an error.

properties.name: components.time-picker.input-decoration.enabled-border
properties.description: The border to display when the input decorator is enabled and is not showing an error.

properties.name: components.time-picker.input-decoration.align-label-with-hint
properties.description: Aligns the label with the hint at the top of the field instead of the center. Use it for fields with several lines.

properties.name: components.time-picker.input-decoration.constraints
properties.description: Defines minimum and maximum sizes for the input decorator. Typically the decorator will fill the horizontal space it is given.

properties.name: components.time-picker.input-decoration.visual-density
properties.description: Defines how compact the decoration's layout will be. When the visual density is compact, the vertical aspect of content padding is reduced by 8 pixels.

properties.name: components.time-picker.padding
properties.description: The padding around the time picker dialog when the entry mode is dial or dial only.

properties.name: components.time-picker.shape
properties.description: The shape of the dialog that the time picker is presented in.

properties.name: components.time-picker.time-selector-separator-color
properties.description: The color of the time selector separator between the hour and minute controls.

properties.name: components.time-picker.time-selector-separator-text-style
properties.description: Used to configure the text style for the time selector separator between the hour and minute controls.

properties.name: components.tooltip.shape
properties.description: The shape of the tooltip background. Together with background it replaces decoration.

properties.name: components.tooltip.background
properties.description: The fill color of the tooltip. Together with shape it replaces decoration.

properties.name: components.tooltip.decoration
properties.description: The tooltip's shape and background color.

properties.name: components.tooltip.constraints
properties.description: Constrains the size of the tooltip's message.

properties.name: components.tooltip.padding
properties.description: The space between the tooltip text and the edge of the tooltip.

properties.name: components.tooltip.margin
properties.description: The empty space around the tooltip.

properties.name: components.tooltip.vertical-offset
properties.description: The vertical gap between the widget and the displayed tooltip.

properties.name: components.tooltip.prefer-below
properties.description: Whether the tooltip appears below the widget when there is room. Set it to false to show it above, so a finger or the cursor does not cover it.

properties.name: components.tooltip.exclude-from-semantics
properties.description: Whether the message should be excluded from the semantics tree. Set this property to true if the app is going to provide its own custom semantics label.

properties.name: components.tooltip.text-style
properties.description: The style to use for the message of tooltips.

properties.name: components.tooltip.text-align
properties.description: The text align to use for the message of tooltips.

properties.name: components.tooltip.wait-duration
properties.description: The length of time that a pointer must hover over a tooltip's widget before the tooltip will be shown.

properties.name: components.tooltip.show-duration
properties.description: The length of time that the tooltip will be shown once it has appeared.

properties.name: components.tooltip.exit-duration
properties.description: The length of time that a pointer must have stopped hovering over a tooltip's widget before the tooltip will be hidden.

properties.name: components.tooltip.trigger-mode
properties.description: The tooltip trigger mode that will show the tooltip.

properties.name: components.tooltip.enable-feedback
properties.description: Whether a tap or a long press gives a sound or a vibration.

properties.name: cupertino.primary-color
properties.description: A color used on interactive elements of the theme. This color is generally used on text and icons in buttons and tappable elements.

properties.name: cupertino.text-theme.primary-color
properties.description: The color of the text that shows an action, such as a button label or a link. The tint of the iOS text styles.

properties.name: cupertino.text-theme.text-style
properties.description: The text style of general text content for Cupertino widgets.

properties.name: cupertino.text-theme.action-text-style
properties.description: The text style of interactive text content such as text in a button without background.

properties.name: cupertino.text-theme.tab-label-text-style
properties.description: The text style of unselected tabs.

properties.name: cupertino.text-theme.nav-title-text-style
properties.description: The text style of titles in standard navigation bars.

properties.name: cupertino.text-theme.nav-large-title-text-style
properties.description: The text style of large titles in sliver navigation bars.

properties.name: cupertino.text-theme.nav-action-text-style
properties.description: The text style of interactive text content in navigation bars.

properties.name: cupertino.text-theme.picker-text-style
properties.description: The text style of pickers.

properties.name: cupertino.text-theme.date-time-picker-text-style
properties.description: The text style of date time pickers.

properties.name: cupertino.primary-contrasting-color
properties.description: A color that must be easy to see when rendered on a primary color background. For example, this color is used for a cupertino button's text and icons when the button's background is primary color.

properties.name: cupertino.scaffold-background-color
properties.description: Background color of the scaffold.

properties.name: cupertino.bar-background-color
properties.description: Background color of the top nav bar and bottom tab bar.

properties.name: cupertino.selection-handle-color
properties.description: The color of the selection handles on the text field.

properties.name: cupertino.apply-theme-to-all
properties.description: Flag to apply this theme to all descendant Cupertino widgets. Certain Cupertino widgets previously didn't use theming, matching past versions of iOS.
